universities.name: University of Georgia
universities.summary: University of Georgia is a private, multi-school university in Tbilisi. Its School of Health Sciences offers a six-year, 360-ECTS English Medicine programme leading to the Medical Doctor qualification, with a stated USD 6,500 annual international fee.
universities.campusLifestyle: UG lists the School of Health Sciences alongside science and technology, law, social sciences, arts and humanities, and business schools. The university's international-student site places its main Tbilisi contact at 77a M. Kostava Street and separately provides travel, health-insurance and visa information for incoming students.
universities.cityProfile: The programme is based in Tbilisi, Georgia's capital. UG's international portal gives a campus address at 77a M. Kostava Street, Tbilisi 0171, and directs applicants to its international-student information pages for practical arrival topics. No university-wide living-cost figure is published with the Medicine fee, so housing and daily expenses should be budgeted separately.
universities.practicalExposure: UG's published Medicine curriculum is a one-cycle, 360-ECTS programme leading to Medical Doctor (MD). The programme document describes a six-year structure and identifies the qualification, but the reviewed current sources do not name a teaching-hospital network or a mandatory clinical-placement site. This payload therefore does not infer hospital access or licensing outcomes from the programme title.
universities.hostelOverview: The reviewed UG international pages provide travel and transportation information but do not publish a university-managed medicine hostel, accommodation price, or guaranteed room allocation. Applicants should obtain current housing options and costs from the Office of International Student Services before making an enrolment decision.
universities.dietarySupport: UG's reviewed international pages do not publish a meal plan, dedicated Indian dining service, or a standard food-cost figure for Medicine students. The university's stated tuition is treated separately from daily living costs.
universities.safetyOverview: The reviewed UG international pages do not make a standalone campus-safety claim. They do provide international-student information for visa requirements, travel and transportation, and health insurance; students should use those university channels for arrival and settlement questions.
universities.studentSupport: UG maintains an Office of International Student Services and International Relations and provides dedicated international pages for how to apply, visa requirements, travel and transportation, health insurance and frequently asked questions. Those published routes are the university's clearest documented support pathway for an incoming international student.

UG's current international tuition page lists the English Program of Medical Education (MD) at USD 6,500 per year.

faq.question: Is University of Georgia a public or private university?
faq.answer: UG describes itself through a multi-school university structure and is catalogued here as a private institution. Its official international site identifies the Tbilisi campus at 77a M. Kostava Street and offers a separate Office of International Student Services and International Relations.

faq.question: Is UG Medicine taught in English?
faq.answer: Yes. UG's Medicine programme document identifies English as the language of instruction. The same document describes Medicine as a one-cycle higher-education programme leading to the Medical Doctor (MD) qualification.

faq.question: How long is the UG English Medicine programme?
faq.answer: UG states that Medicine comprises 360 ECTS credits. Its programme document identifies the programme as a six-year, one-cycle qualification leading to Medical Doctor (MD).

faq.question: What does UG list as the international Medicine fee?
faq.answer: UG's current international tuition page lists the English Program of Medical Education (MD) at USD 6,500 per year. The page does not provide a full six-year total, accommodation cost, or living-cost estimate, so those items are not included as an official fee quote.

faq.question: What English level does UG require for Medicine?
faq.answer: UG's Medicine programme document states B2 English. It names TOEFL, IELTS, FCE and CERTUS as accepted ways to prove English competence, while applicants without one of those certificates take a university English assessment.

faq.question: How does an international applicant apply to UG Medicine?
faq.answer: For the international-entry route in UG's Medicine document, applicants submit the documents required under the Georgian education ministry procedure, demonstrate B2 English, and complete a Biology-Chemistry-Physics admission exam or interview. UG separately provides an international how-to-apply page.

faq.question: Does UG publish a Medicine hostel or living-cost figure?
faq.answer: The reviewed international tuition and programme pages do not publish a university-managed medicine hostel, a room price, or a standard living-cost figure. Students should request current housing information from the Office of International Student Services before committing.

universities.name: Caucasus International University
universities.summary: Caucasus International University is a private Tbilisi university founded in 1995 as the medical institute Clinician. Its English Medical Educational Program is a six-year, 12-semester, 360-credit one-cycle MD with a published USD 6,000 annual tuition fee.
universities.campusLifestyle: CIU operates across business and technology, social sciences and humanities, law, medicine, and viticulture and enology. Its student-facing services include an electronic library restricted to registered university users; CIU says the library contains programme-organised textbooks in multiple languages. The university's international portal also provides online registration, visa, living and transport guidance.
universities.cityProfile: CIU is located at 73 Chargali Street, Tbilisi. Its international-student portal discusses practical matters such as online registration, visa requirements, living and dining, and travel and transportation. CIU has not published one fixed annual living-cost budget for English Medicine students, so the stated USD tuition should not be treated as a complete annual budget.
universities.practicalExposure: CIU's English Medical Educational Program is a full-time, one-cycle MD of 360 credits over six years and 12 semesters. The programme structure includes basic, clinical, clinical-skills, scientific-research-skills and optional modules. CIU's Faculty of Medicine also describes a Clinical Skills Center and says practical teaching in clinical disciplines takes place at affiliated and partner clinics and medical institutions.
universities.hostelOverview: CIU's reviewed international pages provide living and dining information but do not state that a university hostel is guaranteed for Medicine students or publish a medicine-specific accommodation fee. Applicants should request current housing availability, location and cost directly from CIU before paying an enrolment deposit.
universities.dietarySupport: CIU's international-student materials reference living and dining information, but the reviewed sources do not publish a dedicated Indian meal service, a mandatory meal plan or a standard food-cost figure for English Medicine students.
universities.safetyOverview: The reviewed CIU sources do not make a standalone campus-safety claim. They do identify institutional support routes including the International Relations Department, Student Service Office and Medical Office; international students can also use CIU's published visa and travel information before arrival.
universities.studentSupport: CIU's published structure includes a Student Service Office, International Relations Department, Lifelong Learning and Career Development Service, Medical Office, and youth and culture services. For an incoming student, the university also provides international pages for online registration, visa requirements, living and dining, and travel and transportation.

The official international programme listing states USD 6,000 annual tuition for Medical Educational Program in English.
CIU's current authorization/accreditation register lists Medicine in English as an accredited one-cycle Medicine programme.

Foreign-student eligibility is governed by the categories and timeframes set by Georgia's education ministry; applicants need to match their own education history to those categories.

faq.question: Is Caucasus International University public or private?
faq.answer: CIU describes itself as a private higher-education institution. It says it was founded in 1995 as the medical institute Clinician and later developed into a multi-faculty university in Tbilisi.

faq.question: Is CIU Medicine taught in English?
faq.answer: Yes. CIU's programme listing is titled Medical Educational Program in English. The official programme material states that the tuition language is English and the qualification awarded is Medical Doctor (MD).

faq.question: How long is CIU's English Medicine programme?
faq.answer: CIU lists a 360-credit workload over six years and 12 semesters. The programme is described as a full-time, one-cycle medical degree leading to Medical Doctor (MD).

faq.question: What annual tuition does CIU publish for English Medicine?
faq.answer: CIU's official programme search result lists USD 6,000 tuition for Medical Educational Program in English. The university does not publish a complete six-year total or one standard living-cost amount in that listing.

faq.question: What English requirement does CIU state?
faq.answer: CIU's English Medicine programme PDF states that applicants need at least B1 English. It says this can be proved by certificate or by a university-administered test when no certificate is presented.

faq.question: Who can use CIU's foreign-student admission route?
faq.answer: CIU's programme document lists foreign citizens and stateless persons who studied abroad and acquired general education, along with several defined foreign-education and credit-transfer categories. The route is subject to Georgian ministry rules and timeframes, so applicants should compare their own education history to the published categories.

faq.question: Does CIU publish accommodation for English Medicine students?
faq.answer: CIU publishes living and dining information for international students, but the reviewed sources do not promise a medicine hostel, room allocation or accommodation price. Request current housing options directly from the university before planning costs.
